content: अविद्य {%a.%} .²1 Not educated, unlearned, foolish, unwise, अविद्यानां तु सर्वेषामीहात श्चेद्धनं भवेत् <ls>Ms. 9. 205</ls>; also अविद्यक {%a.%} <ls>Mb. 5. 160. 64</ls>. .²2 Not pertaining to knowledge. .{@-द्या@} .²1 Ignorance, folly, want of learning. अविद्यायामन्तरे वर्तमानाः <ls>Muṇḍ. 1. 2. 8</ls>. .²2 Spiritual ignorance; <ls>Av. 11. 8. 23</ls>; <ls>Vāj. 40. 12</ls>, <ls n="Vāj. 40.">14</ls>. .²3 Illusion, illusion personified or Māyā (a term frequently occurring in Vedānta; by means of this illusion one perceives the universe, which does not really exist, as inherent in Brahman which alone really exists). The term appears also in the systems of Gautama, Patañjali, Kapila, where it has different bearings; (with Buddhists) ignorance together with non-existence.
